## Summary

I've successfully added a `currency` setting to the `Config` class with a default value of `"USD"`. 

**What was changed:**
- Added `currency: str = "USD"` to the Config dataclass in `ledger/config.py`

**Why this approach:**
The existing `load()` function uses `fields(Config)` to dynamically discover and validate all configuration fields, so the new `currency` setting automatically becomes configurable via `ledger.toml` without needing any code changes to the loading mechanism. Users can now set a custom currency by adding `currency = "EUR"` (or any other value) to their `ledger.toml` file.

**Tests:** All 4 existing tests pass ✓
